page.notes: Running head is printed "De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf."; long s rendered as s. Left margin word beside "legibus puniuntor" is printed as an unclear word, read here as "Accijs" with [?]. Left margin note "Iudices controversiæ ab ordinib. generalibus dati" is abbreviated and split across lines; "cō" is a tilde abbreviation for controversiæ. Some paragraph indents are faint; the break before "Omnia haec" is judged from indentation. The catchword "tibus" completes "paten-tibus" on the next page.
